    output_ptr,  # Pointer to the output

    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,  # Block size for parallel processing

    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)
    
    # Calculate the start index for this program instance
    block_start = pid * BLOCK_SIZE
    
    # Calculate offsets for this program instance
    offsets = block_start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
    
    # Create a mask to handle edge cases (when the tensor size is not a multiple of BLOCK_SIZE)
    mask = offsets < n_elements
    
    # Load the input data
    x = tl.load(x_ptr + offsets, mask=mask)
    
    # Compute softplus: log(1 + exp(x))
    # For numerical stability, when x > 20, softplus(x) ≈ x
    # When x < -20, softplus(x) ≈ exp(x)
    threshold = 20.0
    
    # For x > threshold, use x directly to avoid overflow
    large_x_mask = x > threshold
    # For x < -threshold, use exp(x) to avoid underflow
    small_x_mask = x < -threshold
    # For values in between, use the standard formula
    normal_mask = ~large_x_mask & ~small_x_mask & mask

    # Handle small x: softplus(x) ≈ exp(x)
